svg.text: Left to right: sprite frames 1, 2, 3. The table shows the idle loop after 2 minutes and the resting frame after 5 minutes.
Drizzle · cloudy morning · odd-hour heavy rain/snow
Before 2 min without cursor movement over Aura: normal three-frame animation. From 2 to 5 min: mood loop above. After 5 min: freeze at the listed frame.
Moving the cursor over Aura wakes the normal animation. Sick holds frame 3 for the first 2 minutes of idle mode, then frame 1 until resting.
Low battery → special date → night → thunderstorm → heat → heavy rain/snow → drizzle → sunny weekend → Monday morning → meal hours → clear day → cloudy morning → evening → idle.
Battery cue is available only when macOS exposes battery level to the app; weather currently uses the Barcelona feed.
